report_name: EU Cyber Resilience Act's 24-Hour Reporting Mandate Starts Sept 11

identities.name: European Union
identities.description: A political and economic union that enacted the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) regulation.

identities.name: European Union Agency for Cybersecurity (ENISA)
identities.description: The EU agency for cybersecurity, designated to receive mandatory vulnerability and incident reports from manufacturers under the Cyber Resilience Act and is launching a Single Reporting Platform.

identities.name: European Commission
identities.description: The executive branch of the European Union, mentioned for providing guidance on the CRA's definition of 'awareness' for reporting purposes.

identities.name: Manufacturers of products with digital elements
identities.description: The class of hardware and software producers who sell products in the EU and are subject to the new mandatory 24-hour reporting obligations under the Cyber Resilience Act.
